sections.body:
HP 420
Strength B+ · Endurance A · Agility A+ · Mana EX · Luck D · Noble Phantasm EX

- Presence Concealment (EX): spiritually unregistered; detection struggles to see him as a Servant.
- Divinity (A): corrupted divine core.
- Corruption Authority (A++): taints mana, bounded fields and constructs on contact.
- Whisper of Ruin (A+): speaking a target's name weakens their parameters.
- Adversary of Order (EX): command, contract and hierarchy skills weaken near him.

Noble Phantasm: Ahriman: Silent Eclipse of Creation (EX, Anti-Unit / Anti-Concept): strikes the body and the target's future survival odds; healing weakens, divine protection fractures.
